run_inference_benchmark: run the mmdet inference benchmark with a config and checkpoint file for model speed measurement
run_dataloader_benchmark: run the mmdet dataloader benchmark to measure data loading throughput for train, val, or test datasets
run_dataset_benchmark: run the mmdet dataset benchmark to measure dataset iteration performance with configurable iterations
run_benchmark_main: run the mmdet benchmark CLI tool with config, task type, checkpoint, and distributed launcher options
parse_benchmark_args: parse command line arguments for mmdet benchmark including task, repeat count, max iterations, and log interval
